page.overview:
What is FORMA?

Unlike most LEGO themes, the theme is an experimental theme that was launched as a crowdfunding project to see if adult LEGO fans would be receptive to a theme based around display sets. The theme contains large and elaborate models with "skins" to completely refurbish the model if the builder desires.
